author: BlueNagisa
quote: GTA VI feels like a scam. The PS5 version is obviously just a stepping stone, and the definitive version will come to PS6 with better graphics and performance. Meanwhile, I'm stuck with a full-price digital copy I can't even resell or refound. Rockstar knows this and is happy to make people pay twice. Wait for the PS6 version.

author: BlueNagisa
quote:
Still the gold standard. Ocarina of Time showed what 3D adventure games could be, and it holds up remarkably well. The dungeons are brilliantly designed, the Water Temple included, and Z-targeting still feels intuitive. Koji Kondo's soundtrack is unforgettable, and the jump from young Link to adult Link is still one of gaming's greatest moments. Hyrule Field, Kakariko Village and the Shadow Temple all have an atmosphere few games have matched since.

Playing it again on Switch 2 shows how much later games owe to it. It's a masterpiece and an easy 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
